patches.acceptance_test: ACQUISITION-ACCEPTANCE-2026-08-31. Two games, no owner upload, primary rail genuinely blocked. Seven BLOCKED, one NOT_FOUND and one STALE_REJECTED all advanced; current availability, a 12-game MLB slate and a probable starter were acquired at rung 6; forecasts were produced for both games; actionability gated separately and PASSed for reasons unrelated to forecast availability.
patches.architectural_correction: WebFetch and WebSearch are TOOLS IN THE AGENT LOOP, not Python callables. No Python function can invoke them, so a session-bootstrap `get=` implementation is not constructible in this deployment. feed_espn and acquisition_adapters keep refusing by default and that stays correct. The orchestrator DRIVES the agent loop instead of replacing it, and the CI gate is the real enforcement because it catches premature termination whoever caused it.
changes: harness/acquisition_orchestrator.py — the execution plane. next_action() emits the next UNTRIED authorized rung as an instruction; record_attempt() advances on BLOCKED, NOT_FOUND, STALE_REJECTED, CONTAMINATED, TITLES_ONLY and ERROR alike; disposition() refuses a terminal answer while any authorized rung is untried and returns ACQUISITION_INCOMPLETE naming what is still owed.
assert_no_premature_termination() — CI gate. UNKNOWN, BLOCKED or NO_FORECAST over an unfinished ladder fails the build.

ADVANCING_OUTCOMES made load-bearing. It was computed, stored on every attempt as `advances`, and consulted by nothing — the compute-then-discard shape, found in the code written to fix an instance of it.
Mutation suite polarity corrected; it reported 0/4 killed while claiming to pass.
patches.incident: 2026-08-30. Searching for Atlanta Dream availability returned a report 32 days stale. THE REJECTION WAS CORRECT. Terminating on it was not: the run reported AVAILABILITY_UNKNOWN, when the correct classification was ACQUISITION_INCOMPLETE. One more query on the SAME working rail returned the current report immediately. The failure was query specificity plus premature termination, not source availability.
patches.problem: The repo had an acquisition CONTROL plane and no EXECUTION plane. route_ladder_v1 defines seven rungs and states that a blocked rail advances the ladder and that acquisition cannot terminate while an authorized route remains untried — but its entry point takes an ALREADY-COLLECTED set of attempts and rules on sufficiency. It can say 'you stopped too soon'. It cannot make anything continue.
patches.residual: OWNER_RELAY remains untried on all three ladders — correctly, since acquisition succeeded first. MLB MIA@WSH has NO canonical id because statsapi is blocked on both paths, so it is forecastable now and not bindable later. No id was invented.
